label: 退款逾期保留追责权利
description: 当前时间超过断更退款请求（request.refund）的截止时间，且符合订阅合同（contract.subscription）已付款和断更下架条件的请求尚无恰好一份期限内全额退款到账凭证（confirmation.refund）时，判定断更退款履约（fulfillment.refund）逾期。
expression:
now > request.expired_at && !(request.subscription_id ==
agreement.subscription_id && request.reader_id ==
agreement.reader_id && request.column_id == agreement.column_id &&
payments.exists(p, p.subscription_id == agreement.subscription_id &&
p.reader_id == agreement.reader_id && p.column_id ==
agreement.column_id && p.amount_minor_units ==
agreement.amount_minor_units && p.currency == agreement.currency &&
p.success && p.confirmed_at >= agreement.signed_at && p.confirmed_at
<= agreement.signed_at + duration(string(agreement.payment_seconds)
+ "s")) && notices.exists(n, n.subscription_id ==
request.subscription_id && n.reader_id == request.reader_id &&
n.column_id == request.column_id && n.created_at <=
request.started_at && n.created_at > n.missed_due_at +
duration("604800s") && n.missing_content && !n.rescheduled &&
n.delisted) && request.amount_minor_units ==
agreement.amount_minor_units && request.currency ==
agreement.currency && confirmations.filter(c, c.request_id ==
request.request_id && c.subscription_id == request.subscription_id
&& c.reader_id == request.reader_id && c.column_id ==
request.column_id && c.confirmed_at >= request.started_at &&
c.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at && c.settled &&
c.amount_minor_units == request.amount_minor_units && c.currency ==
request.currency).size() == 1)
